title: Overworld Overhaul
description: This mod aims to add new biomes to Minecraft, staying as vanilla as possible.
body:
The Overworld Overhaul mod is a Vanilla Plus mod that aims to add new biomes to Minecraft that feel as vanilla as possible without breaking game progression.

**Version 1.0.0**


BIOMES
**Desert Cave**
Cave Biome with Sand, Sandstone, Moss, etc
Has plants like Dry Grass, Bushes, etc

**Redwood Forest**
Forest Biome with very tall trees stretching 15+ blocks tall
Has taiga rocks, new flowers, ferns and grass 
Podzol patches on the ground, maybe course dirt

BLOCKS
**Sandstone Bricks**
Has Stairs, Slabs, Wall, Chiseled, and Pillar blocks


**Calcite Bricks**
Brick, Stair, Slab, Wall, Chiseled, Pillar blocks

**Amethyst Bricks**
Brick, Stair, Slab, Wall, Chiseled, Pillar blocks

**Redwood Wood Set**


STRUCTURES
**Digsite
**Small 4x4 square of sand that can spawn with sus sand

**Ancient Ruins
**
Ring of 8 pillars, 2 pillars have chests with loot

**Cabin**
Small house built with redwood and dark oak, gives basic starter loot. Exclusive item?

FLOWERS
Blueleaf 
Brixandrea 
Fiery Flower
Gradient Flower


VERSION 1.1.0 COMING SOON!
